chapters: Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ daam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Salomoon bɨx gu Israeel bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu Israeel ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Salomoon bɨɨx bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't gu Gabaoon; na gu' ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oidha' jix gaki.

Gu' gu' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kîriat-jearim pai' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur ka't vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Salomoon bɨɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salomoon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut makgɨrxi bhaan mambhɨɨx gɨ' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim tu' jix maa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Dabii gu taat; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p oo' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' matda' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam baakɨi vupui bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam; na gu' chɨkka guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' dhi' ka't gu i'ii'ñ cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa namkɨm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' gu i'ii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mui'x gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' tu' matda' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' matda' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' gio tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ namkɨm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gɇ'kamtu'nda' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ va'k tu' mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't gu Gabaoon vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhiibgich guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Ejipto na ba' gu Salomoon; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhiibgich.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai kavaayo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu kavɨk vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro; gio ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu vaak no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' bhaan bɨx gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' chɨkka ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai ñakaabma' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gio gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Liibano; na gu' tu' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Na gu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'u na gu' gu vaak no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu u'u jix maa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tiriik kai'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kai' vaas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhañ gu Salomoon; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn chɨtda gu iram; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duu gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't gu iram gu taat.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Dan gu' gu taat ka't gu Tiro; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai gu u'u ñakaabma' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan tu duukam tiriik kai' vaas bɨ'ñdhatu' suudai' u'va tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' no'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Liibano gu u'u jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Joppe tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix duu mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel mi' dhɨr tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii gu taat jix bɨɨx duu bakia' chamaam mambhɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu kavɨk vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm daam na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Komensoo gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu kavɨk gu Moria ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii gu taat pai' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' kua'da' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maakobh oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Salomoon guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak tu jiim chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak jix gɨ' bɨɨx gu u'u ka't jix bhaan dhaas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix uam jodai tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio gu vaak gu jodai a'bhar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jix uam jodai ka't jix uam jodai gu Parbaim.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiki'ñgob bɨɨx jix uam jodai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu jiim pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ duñiaꞌ a'aalh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn juu'ñdham tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn juu'ñdham tɨkɨr ka't jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn juu'ñdham tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' mi'p tɨɨt bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ñakaabma' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu vupui bhaan gu vaak gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu jiim jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix dhaas bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu novɨ jix duu o'nsop; gio ba' gu novɨ jix duu jup tɨɨt gu Jakîn o'nsop gu Boas.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ga'ra' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' tu jiim ka't jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xikoolh.

Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mambhɨɨx novɨ maa'nkar bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax vaik tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaik tas gei'ñ vaik saagi'ñ vaik tas buusñi; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan mi'p baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jannulhi'ñ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx suudai' buusñi jix dhaas jixchamaam o'nsop na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan; gu' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't na ba' tu jiim jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai bhaan duñiaꞌ jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam o'nsop.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Ademaas mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam o'nsop; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix bhaan dhaas kiki'ñgob jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu bhaan tas buusñi guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu iram guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu iram tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan ɨɨbhidham gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gook a'sak na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mi'p tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mi'p tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax bɨtaa'n.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' bɨx jix duu gu iram gu taat gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jordaan gu oidha' u'u gat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sukôt gu Seredat.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gaagam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu takarui' tɨkiix.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam daa'nkar tai na jix tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim jix duu jix uam jodai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ba'k gu vaak kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiki'ñgob gu vaak vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Akabada ka't bɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Salomoon tu'x gu Dabii gu taat ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' jix dhaas jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem daraa gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xidhuu mi'p vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bhɨɨk.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan kakneer gu vaakax guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu' cham tu jiim dɨr mai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' cham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Moisees ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oreb bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.

Na gu' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan moor xidhuu na gu' bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mi'p bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tas buusñi jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' bɨɨx chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' gu mar kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bham; na gu' jix bhai' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' gu vaak jix bhuup jano' ba' toov gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha toov; na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ na ba' tu' ba'bhak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui jix bhai' aa' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin gu Dabii gu taat bham.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto matgɨm kiicham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' jum duu bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' xoi'kam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' gu i'ii'ñ.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu mar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' pai' gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios daakat atooxkor gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Salomoon vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu jiim vaik guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jix dhaas bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨkbok vupui bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel jix duu gu noobh gu tɨkɨr jix aa'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios nɨidhim tu' gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix nukadham tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ atooxkor gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ja'p tu' vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii.

Gu' gu' tu'r gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Miren gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ soi'm tu duukam soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu ñi'ook soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan dhi' gu vaak gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bhaan pai' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga dhi' pai'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ soi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk dhi' pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat soi'm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ; na guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan tɨtmo taan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook kavɨk aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ daraibu' vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu duukam jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jir bhai' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan tu' dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' chɨɨdak tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat uañi'ñ bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' dhi' pai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk jix duu.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu bhóogɨt na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu oidha' chɨɨdak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' bhiogi' gu oidha' tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' mia'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr no'x guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ko'kdai' ka't.

Jano' ba' bɨx soi'm bɨx soi'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel no'x guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' ba'bhak uañi'ñka' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt dhaibu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat.

Jano' ba' gio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel bhɨɨya' tɨbiap guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kuiñcha jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ jix duu jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhɨɨya' duuñ tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tu' tɨip guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' bhaan dhi' kiicham tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr soi'm soi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' jix duu bhaan kɨɨsa' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mia'n.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' pai' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa baabuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak tattat bhaan kiicham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ soi'm soi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kuiñcha uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bamii' jano' na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu kavɨk; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jajannulhi'ñ tulhiiñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn xoi'kam jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui Xoi'kam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tai jix dhaav gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak.
Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios baakɨi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak ia'rɨ gu oidha' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn o'lhia tɨtdada' gu Jawatan Dios bham; na jix bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu vaakax chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' gu Lebitas bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.

Na gu' gio jix bhaan duu gu Salomoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dɨr ba'k gu amat bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Ejipto.

Na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv bhañ gu ja'tkam dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu Salomoon guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim aagak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu tukaa'; gio ba' tu' naak soi'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' tu' dhi' pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨkɨr cham ka't dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tomaat gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dɨr gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios uañi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' no'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.
Na gu' jano' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' gu vaak na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ no'm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' jix duu nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' jix maa; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tattat jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ o'lhia guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx dhi' cham bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Salomoon jɨ'dɨlh gu iram ka't jix maa dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Salomoon gu Amat gu Soba jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Tadmor oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam pai'x gu amat.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Bet-oron jiix gu Bet-oron guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak jodai kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Baalat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon ga'ra'; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jerusalem gu Liibano bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Salomoon bopxi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix dhaas gu Salomoon tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chiñia' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Salomoon mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' jix aa'; na gu' gu u'vɨ cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na gu' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai' tu' kia'mi'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu Salomoon maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaik mui'kim oidha' tas maachim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob; na gu' ka't jix duu gu Dabii gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham moor gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' bɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't gu Esion-geber gu Elot guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Edom.

Na gu' na gu' gu iram ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon gu Opir guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix uam jodai aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu Oyendo guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Salomoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix uam jodai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu jodai a'bhar na ba' vaak zel gu Salomoon bɨɨx tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Salomoon tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Gu' gu' gu Salomoon jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Salomoon cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' koi' meesa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r ka't naak gu oidha' tu'x matda'.

Gu' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat matda' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' daam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ matda'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan atooxkor guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cha'tmam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gio tu duukam gu iram tu duukam gu Salomoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix uam jodai gu Opir aichdhak gu u'u gu Algummim gu jodai a'bhar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu Algummim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu Judaa ka't buupui gu u'u nɨidhim.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Salomoon oidha' tas ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cha'tmam jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gio bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia chiñia' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n ga'ra' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaik kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ua'tulhdhidha' kutun kavɨk vaik guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam atooxkor bɨɨx dhaibu' jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi'p ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' ka't gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam baasɨ'n; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam nɨidhim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oi'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't jix uam jodai bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Liibano jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix toja jodai cham ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Tarsis bɨɨx tu duukam gu iram vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Tarsis guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga matda'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' suulhgia' maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio gu Salomoon maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' kavaayo na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim aapi' bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p chiiw guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu Salomoon gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' gɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon dharka' jix duu cham bɨx ua'nak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Iddo bhaan gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Na gu' gu Roboam ka't gu Sikêm na gu' gu Sikêm ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu Israeel na ba' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat ka't gu Ejipto pai' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.

Jano' ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ juantu'n guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu taat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx nu'aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam tu jiim ñiokda' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix maa nu'aa' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx biipibop guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu bɨɨx vupui bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' daipu' gu ja'tkam tu' tu ñi'ook bham gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr daipu'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu taat.

Na ba' gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam vaik gu tanoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duu bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ nu'aa'.

Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' kuiñcha ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar gu Isaii gu Israeel maa'n dhi' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak ka't bɨx gu Israeel dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu Adoram ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bopxi'ñ; gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Israelitas gu Judaa gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n gu vaak na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bet-leem gu Etam gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-sur gu Sokô gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu Gat gu Maresa gu Sip.
Jano' ba' gu Adoraim gu Lakîs gu Akekâ.
Jano' ba' gu Sora gu Ajaloon gu ebroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Judaa gu Benjamiin mi'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas mi'p bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa aajidha' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu Jeroboam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' i'ii'mda' na ba' ali' vaakax ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na gu' vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Roboam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Maalat mar u'vɨ gu Jerimot gu mar gu Dabii gu Abiail mar u'vɨ gu Eliab gu mar gu Esaii.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Jeus gu Samaria gu Saam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abiiyas gu Atai gu Sisa gu Selomit.

Gu' gu' gu Roboam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix mar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Na gu' jix dhaas gu Roboam gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Maakâ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Judaa gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk jix maa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel.
Na gu' jixchamaam oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Ejipto cham ga'ra' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; mi' dhɨr maachim gu Libios gu Sukienos gu Etiopes.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Semeiias gu Roboam chiñia' gu Judaa mi'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Sisak; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gio tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu noobh gu Sisak.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gui'p; gio ba' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; jano' ba' va'k dodhia' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Sisak.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't tu duukam; na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix duu pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam do'ñcho gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ba'k gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios aajidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix na ba' cham cham tu' duu bɨx; gio ba' gio gu Judaa tu'x jix bɨɨx duu xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Roboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Roboam oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' na gu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu'x gu Roboam tumiiñku jix duu cham ua'ñix guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Semeiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Iddo guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Roboam bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Abiiyas gu mar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Abiiyas bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Mikâiia mar u'vɨ gu Uriel gu Gabaa; mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Abiiyas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abiiyas bhaan gu kavɨk gu Semaraim gu kakkavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ma'nkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Gu' gu' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat tu duukam gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii jix búup guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan.

Na gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon na gu' gu Roboam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Dabii na gu' mui'x namki' bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ali' vaakax jix uam jodai gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' no'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim bɨɨx tuur kɨɨv gu chuukug ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨtda:―Cha'pim; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' bhaan meesa na jix bhai' mɨichdhai jix uam jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu xumai; na gu' no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jeroboam tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' kua' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu jiim gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ga'ra' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Abiiyas gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jiboi'ññor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu Abiiyas gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' ia'rɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu' gu Jesana bɨɨx taañpu' gu Epraim bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tanoolh gu Abiiyas; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios jix koi.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Abiiyas; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'vɨ jix mar guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Abiiyas gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ua'nak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Iddo jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu Durmioo gu Abiiyas bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu mar gu Asa gu tanoolh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Asa jix bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tattat jaisaidhat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ juruuñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu oidha' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak jodai bɨɨx gɨ' vaak kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio gu Asa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu Judaa vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'u gat; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix buus bhaan gu Sera gu Etiope bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix duu vaik guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Maresa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buus gu Asa bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sepata ju'ñdharan gu Maresa.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook gu Asa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx matgɨm gu kavɨk juraa'n na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan dhi' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan tu' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Etiopes vupui bhaan gu Asa vupui bhaan gu Judaa; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu Etiopes.

Jano' ba' gu Asa gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't chɨ'ɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Gerar; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu Etiopes bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh gu Gerar na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh na gu' ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix maa bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ aichdhak mumua'da' kakneer jix ai suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Obed.

Ba' jix aa' jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Asa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Asa bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ua'tulhi'ñ bɨɨx; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't gaagam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gio kiicha'.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' dhi' gu Israeel cham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk chulhiiñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't gaagam.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' na ba' busaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mumua'da' tulhiiñ bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu noobh; na guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tu duukam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Asa gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Obed jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu oidha' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't vupui bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Simeoon; na gu' mui'x gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñɨi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vaik oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Asa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer.
Jano' ba' baap guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tattat bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'x cham tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vaak jodai jix gɨ' jix ali' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu Judaa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx aagak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr ka't gaagam; jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨpi'ñka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Maakâ gu naan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Asa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.

Gu' gu' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'ii'ñ gu Asa ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu taat ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Asa.

Jano' ba' jix duu oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Asa jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa gu Rama na ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' baakɨi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Asa jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam bhañ gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't gu Damasko bham.

Jano' ba' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ja'p ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ben-adad bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa bhañ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chugi'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ion gu Dan gu Abel-maim jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Neptalii.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Baasa jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Rama guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu Judaa bhɨɨk gu Rama gu jodai gu u'u bɨɨx gu Baasa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu Gibaa gu Mispa.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va gu anani guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh.

Na gu' gu Etiopes gu Libios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨɨx bɨx na gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam namki' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asa bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak kuupa' na gu' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuiñcha dhi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Asa mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhɨt gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Asa dharka' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
