Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Asa tɨɨt na ba' jiix ko'kdai' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Asa bɨɨx tattat jix koi oidha' tas oo'm maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai'm ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɇɇka' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josapat gu mar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Epraim gu taat gu Asa ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Josapat na gu' jix jiim dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Baales.
Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix jiim gu ñi'ook cham bhaan buimɨi gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ bɨx gu Judaa jix maa gu Josapat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' vaik oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhañ chiñia' gu Ben-ail gu Obdiias gu Sakâriias gu Nataniel gu Mikêas na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Lebitas gu Semeiias gu Netaniias gu Sebadiias gu Asael gu Semiramot gu Jonataan gu Adoniias gu Tobiias gu Tobadoniias gu Lebitas; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Elisama gu Joram jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Judaa ua'tulhdhidha' baidhak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mi'p xikoolh gu Judaa; na cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Josapat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josapat bopxi'ñ jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu Arabes gio aichdhak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chuukug kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios chiiw.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Josapat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' pai'x gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mumua'da' buimɨi jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bhaan gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Adna bɨɨx vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Joanaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Amasiias gu mar gu Sikri ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Eliada gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu ñi'ook u'u gat kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Josabad bɨɨx chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Judea.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Josapat namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Akâb.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix dhaav gu Akâb gu Samaria; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Akâb mumua'da' kakneer gu vaakax na ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jum duu bɨɨx gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ramot gu Galaad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gio tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gio gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨndak bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad dhi' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gui'p; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx tas cham bhai'; jano' ba' dhi' gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; gio ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n atooxkor jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kênaana ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai chɨtda; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu bɨx.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gio bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu jiim gu Ramot gu Galaad tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maa'n tu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad dhi' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ boopoya' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't kapbhai' gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mui'kim tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'r.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' buupui bɨx gu Israeel vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' buupui gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't gu novɨ jix duu o'nsop.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ramot gu Galaad maa'n chɨtda.

Ba' jix aa' gu' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chin dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kênaana guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' naaka'n gu Mikêas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt jix ai'chdhix tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' ba'k guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Mikêas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Amoon guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kuupa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' jix duu bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' baakɨi guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨbiapui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' baidhak bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Josapat gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gu' gu Josapat tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu.

Gu' gu' jix duu maa'n u'u gat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' na gu' dhi' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm juruuñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨɨt guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gu' jix koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jeuu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar gu anani gu gɨ'kora' gu Josapat; gio ba' cham bhai' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ u'ua'tɨdham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'x na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Josapat gu Jerusalem; gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios busaak gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn pai' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat pai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu Josapat gu Jerusalem dhɨt gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tattat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bhai'.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kuiñcha daraibu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Amariias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sebadiias gu mar gu Ismael gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Judaa bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Lebitas ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' tu'x ka't gu ma'nkam gu Moab gu Ammoon bɨɨx gu Ammonitas tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Josapat bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix maa aa'ñdham gu Josapat bham; gio ba' bhaan tu' jupaabkamu'n jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Siria; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu asasoon-tamar gu Engedi.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim choo'n; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Josapat gu vupui na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Judaa na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jano' ba' gu Josapat tɨɨt guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix vɨɨk.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat cham jix duu tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gentes cham gu novɨ tu jiim gu kavɨk bɨxchu'x cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel chɨɨdak gu kai' gu Abraam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xidhuu gu tɨɨgɨ' bham.

Na gu' tu' cham bhai' daraibu' bhaan no'ch gu kuchii sɨlhka'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhiogi' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vupui bhaan dhi' gu vaak vupui bhaan tu' na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bopxi'ñ duuñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa u'ua'tɨda'.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk aajidha' gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bai'ñpu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar tu' chɨɨdak guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' na gu' no'ch cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jupaabkamu'n bhaan no'ch; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Judaa ka't tɨɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jaasiel gu mar gu Sakâriias gu mar gu Benaiias gu mar gu Jeiel gu mar gu Mataniias gu Lebita gu ma'nkam gu Asap bhaan suudai' u'va gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Josapat; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' cham bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu xibh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Sis chɨɨmɨlhdhapu' ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn va'k oidha' jix gaki gu Jeruel.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' na ba' dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu xibh bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josapat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Koree na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh moor guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki gu Tekoa; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Josapat kua' tɨɨt jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios boopoya' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan boopoya' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas dhɨt guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ busaak gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; na gu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kua'da' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga aajidha' bhaan gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab jix búup bhaan gu kavɨk gu Seir na ba' kooda' cham tu' duu; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Seir guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chajaañ duiñchu'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oidha' jix gaki tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' koko'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' jano' ba' gu Josapat gu ja'tkam tu jiim gu ñi'ook mumua'da' namkɨm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim jajannulhi'ñ na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na gu' vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na gu' ka't jix jai'.

Jano' ba' maakobh gu tanoolh jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Beraka; na gu' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Beraka bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu Josapat mo'o suulh na ba' tu jiim gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Josapat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨɨpi'ñka'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Josapat bhaan gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Sili.
Jano' ba' jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Josapat dharka' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook gu Jeuu gu mar gu anani guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' tu'x gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx chu'p na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaai'n gu Tarsis; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Esion-geber.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Elieser gu mar gu Dodaba gu Mareosa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Josapat bham; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chu'p bɨɨx gu Okôsiias gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios buimɨi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' gu Tarsis.
Jano' ba' gu Durmioo gu Josapat bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gu mar.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Josapat gu Asariias gu Jeiel gu Sakâriias gu Asariias gu Mikâel gu Sepatiias; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu taat ka't jix maa mui'x juana' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai tu'x a'bhar jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa; na gu' gu' ka't jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Joram na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Joram oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu taat; gio ba' jix duu jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhɨt chiñia' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' ga'ra' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Akâb tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu' duu gu vaak gu Dabii kuiñcha ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Idumea na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Judaa jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Joram bɨɨx chiñia' baidhak bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix búup gu tukaa' tu' naaka'n gu Idumeos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mia'n bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Edom guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Libna na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ; na gu' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kakkavɨk gu Judaa tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Eliiyas am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt gu Josapat gu taat tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Akâb; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix koi gu ja'tkam ja'tkam vaak gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx mumua'da' dudua'ñ bɨɨx ko'kdai' ba'k bɨɨx ka'm ba'k tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kuiñcha ko'kdai' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Joram gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Pilisteos gu Arabes mi'p ju'ñdharan gu Etiopes.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Judaa tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ; na cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Joakâs jix ali' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n ba'k ko'kdai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' ka't bhɨi gu tanoolh bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ba'k moor bɨɨx ko'kdai' vaak jodai ko'kdai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' cham jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' ka't cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu' cham pai'm gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Okôsiias gu mar jix ali'; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't tɨbiap bɨɨx gu Arabes yooxi' ka't jix koi bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix gɨ'kora' gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Okôsiias kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't oo'm gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' oidha' tas gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Ataliia mar u'vɨ gu Omri.
Jano' ba' gio jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' gu naan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' jai'chdhɨlhia'.
Jano' ba' jix jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu Ramot gu Galaad pai' gu Siros jix duu gu Joram.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' jix duu gu Jesreel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Rama guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; na gu' jix dhaav gu Asariias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Jesreel na gu' ka't ka'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Okôsiias jum duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bai'ñpu' gu Joram; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨbiap jix buus bɨɨx gu Joram bhaan gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi gu Jawatan Dios ka't Xoi'kam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Akâb.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jeuu bɨɨx gu vaak gu Akâb gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Okôsiias guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Okôsiias ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Samaria guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam aichdhak gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' jix maa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Josapat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Okôsiias cham ga'ra' tu' na jix kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ataliia gu naan gu Okôsiias ñɨi'ñ gu mar ka't jix koi jix búup guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu kai' vaak ja'tkam gu vaak gu Judaa.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Josabet mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' jix bhɨɨ gu Joas gu mar gu Okôsiias guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josabet mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu u'vɨ gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na gu' ka't gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias vupui bhaan gu Ataliia cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ataliia guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joiada jix bhɨɨ baidhak ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Asariias gu mar gu Jeroam gu Ismael gu mar gu Joanaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Obed gu Maasiias gu mar gu Adaiias gu Elisapat gu mar gu Sikri.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa jum daa'ñ gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa chiñia' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ba'k kia'pɨx no'm tu jiim bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' suulhgia' jɨjɨkgɨm na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; gio ba' no'x ba'k gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na pai' dhuuk dhi' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ba'k na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx gu Judaa jix duu bɨx na ja'p ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kia'pɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam juanda'; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada cham jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix maa gio jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ja'tkam ua'tulhdhidha' maa'n gu kuchii gu novɨ dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas kuruun chuut tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Joiada gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Ataliia jix kai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨɨgɨk jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' ka't ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ba'k chiñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu mar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ alabaa'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Ataliia guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn daañxi'ñdha' gu Joiada guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jix duu cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ba'k ki'ñgob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joiada ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' chɨbiapui bɨx gu ja'tkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' tu' jix duu bapaalh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Mataan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Baal.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joiada guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bhaan gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn xoi'kam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio tu jiim kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm matgɨm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ba'k guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñaanbi'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bai'ñpu' bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob jix gɨ' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix dhadhaa gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' kiicham juruuñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi a'lhiok gu Ataliia guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Siete guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Joas na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Sibia gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joas gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu Joiada gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Joas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim aagak tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tuumiñ bɨx gu Israeel na ba' oidha' tas ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gu' gu Lebitas cham jix dhaas guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Joiada gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Judaa gu Jerusalem vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ataliia gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn duiñxim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix dhaas mai' ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu.

Na pai' dhuuk na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jir bɨx bhai' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Lebitas na pai' dhuuk tu jiim ka't jix jai' tuumiñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix jai' tuumiñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joiada guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨ'ya' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh ka't tu duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook aichdhak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tuumiñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joiada tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Joiada.
Gu' gu' gu Joiada guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix koi guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't na pai' dhuuk jix koi.
Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam bɨɨx gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Joiada tɨɨtɨs chiñia' gu Judaa tu' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix kai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tattat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ suudai' u'va bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Sakâriias gu mar gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kua' bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ɨlhdham xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios gio kiicha'.
Gu' gu' jix duu tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' naadat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chɨ'ñchoka' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu taat gu Joiada ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu mar; gio ba' jix aa' koi; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oidha' tas jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu Damasko.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria ka't tɨbiap bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios tattat; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu Joas jix duu ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Siros guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mumua'da' dudua'ñ; gio ba' tu jiim bhaan tu duukam kuiñcha guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix koi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai'm gu gɨ'kora'.
Na tu jiim bhaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Sabad gu mar gu Simat gu Ammonita gu Josabad gu mar gu Simrit gu Moabita.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ u'uan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Beintikinko guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Amasiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Joaddan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam bhaan ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan gu Moisees pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam tu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tattat; gu' maa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Amasiias gu Judaa bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix dhaas bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix jix bɨɨx duu bakia' vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham ko'kmarak u'u kavɨk kutun kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cha'tmam jix toja jodai.

Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨndak ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham bɨɨx gu Israeel tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Epraim.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Amasiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cha'tmam jix maa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix jai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Amasiias jix ai'chdhix guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam ka't tɨbiap gu Epraim na ba' bhaai'n gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Judaa suulh gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' ba' gu Amasiias jix buusñi gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sal; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu ma'nkam gu Seir mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ko'iix mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' bhɨɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx jix duu bapaalh.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Amasiias ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na gu' cham bhaai'n bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa dɨr gu Samaria bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-oron tu' jix duu vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Amasiias guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Idumeos guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gio baidhak gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Seir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Amasiias bhañ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dhi' tu'x; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Deejate guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu mar gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't gu Liibano bhañ gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't gu Liibano bham; mi' dhɨr jix maa mar u'vɨ gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax tu jiim mi'p gu Liibano guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Edom; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' tas na jix gɨ'; jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' gu Judaa bɨndak.

Gu' gu' gu Amasiias cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨɨsa' gu noobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Edom.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Bet-semes gu Judaa.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Judaa vupui bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-semes gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu mar gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak jodai gu Jerusalem dɨr ki'ñgob gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ bɨx jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam chiñia' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Amasiias dharka' jix duu cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Amasiias jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jerusalem; gio ba' dhaibu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Lakîs mɨjɨ bhaan gu Lakîs guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' aichdhak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu Ussiias ka't mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Elot guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Judaa mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix koox bɨɨx tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Ussiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jekôliia gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Amasiias gu taat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Sakâriias guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix buus guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak jodai gu Gat vaak jodai gu Jabnia vaak jodai gu Asdod; gio ba' pai'x jɨ'dɨlh gu Asdod gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham bhaan gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Arabes oi'ñka' gu Gur-baal bhaan gu Ammonitas.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Ammonitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ussiias guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm ba'k gu Ejipto; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu Ussiias gɨ' vaak gu Jerusalem ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gɨ' vaak oidha' jix gaki jix kupi'ook mumua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kakkavɨk na ja'p guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio gu Ussiias guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Jeiel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Maasiias guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu ananiias maa'n chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ suulhgia' ka't ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhɨɨ'ñdham vaik kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ussiias na ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ u'u gat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix duu gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gɨ' vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim jix kavɨk.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm jix duu; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Asariias bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Ussiias gui'p; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ussiias guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' jix duu; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xidhuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham tu' ka't na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Ussiias ga'ra' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ na ba' jix duu; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan dua'ñdha' jix buus guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Asariias guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dua'ñdha' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mii' dhɨr pai'; na gu' gio jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ussiias ka't gakiidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gakiidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Joatam gu mar guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ussiias dharka' jix duu ua'na gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos.

Jano' ba' jix koox gu Ussiias bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat yooxi' pai'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gakiidha'; jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Joatam gu mar pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Beintikinko guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Joatam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jerusa mar u'vɨ gu Sadok.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Ussiias gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham chɨbiapui vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob jix gɨ' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu kavɨk pai'x jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gɨ' kavɨk gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gɨ' vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon mii' dhɨr oidha' tas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cha'tmam jix toja jodai mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tiriik mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' kai' vaas; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gook oidha' tas vaik.
Na gu' gu Joatam ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na gu' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joatam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joatam bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Akâs gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Beinte guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Akâs na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gu' cham jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv gu chuukug kɨɨv ali' karneer kɨɨv guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios chiiw na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xidhuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa; gio ba' jix aa' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaakax jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chuukug guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ali' karneer guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ɨ'ɨɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix dhaas bhaan gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu Lebitas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Gad guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas mi'p bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Esekîas maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kua'da' maa'nkar tai bhaan kua'da' gio bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ alabaa'n kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu mar kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; gio ba' bɨx bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx bɨɨx mi'p o'lhia.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas chiñia' gui'p gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Asap guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx jix gɨ' bhai' ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam o'lhia.

Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Esekîas; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhai' ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ali' karneer; gio ba' bɨx na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix maa jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer.

Gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' gu Lebitas chooto'n jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu i'ii'ñ na ba' jix bhaan duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Esekîas bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gio gu Esekîas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa ua'na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epraim gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook.

Na gu' na gu' jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu ja'tkam ka't ju'ñdharan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jerusalem; na gu' jix jai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ua'nak.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duu am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ja'p tattat na ja'p gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat do'ñcho guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' cham moimkada' jano' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p tattat; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu xidhuu tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'iich guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch vupui bhaan namki' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vupui tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Epraim gu Manasees bɨɨx ka'm gu Sabuloon; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhɨt gu chichio'ñ gu Aser gu Manasees gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gio ka't gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu Jerusalem; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gio bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx xi'ɨraam aichdhak maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh gu Lebitas.

Na gu' na gu' ka't mui'x guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham mi'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Lebitas maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' jix bhaan duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ja'tkam gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn koi'mɨk gakdhi'ñchix cham jurtu'nka' ua'nak; gu' gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx mii' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu takarui' cham jabka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Esekîas gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Lebitas ko'kmarak jix bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' koi'mɨk maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix maa taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer; gio ba' gio chiñia' jix maa gu ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer; mi' dhɨr mui'x jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Judaa na ja'p gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't tɨbiap gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap gu oidha' gu Israeel oi'ñka' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerusalem; na gu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel cham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu Lebantaandose mi' dhɨr jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam soi'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ba'bhak xidhuu gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gaagam moor guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gio gu Epraim gu Manasees bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' mi' dhɨr suulh bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel maa'n gu maa'nkar jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'n bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gio gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa mumua'da' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' suudai' na jix bhai' bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' aichdhak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam boosgi guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Judaa oi'ñka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix maa boosgi guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer; gio ba' aichdhak boosgi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vaik kua'da' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas chiñia' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gɨ' kavɨk jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn boosgi tu'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kônaniias gu Lebita gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Simi xibhɨk ka't gook.
