Jano' ba' gu novɨ ka't gu Edeen gu Benjamiin gu Jesua gu Semaiias gu Amariias gu Sekâniias jɨ'dɨlh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix gɨ' na ja'p jix ali'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jiix jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu bɨɨx bɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx ja'tkam vaak; na gu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu chio'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Esekîas bɨx gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhai' jix duu jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kua'da' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x dhi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ suudai' u'va gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios chɨbiapui gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam baakɨi.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Esekîas namkia' gu Sennakêrib guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' buusñi gu suudai' mi'p mai' kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ jix jai' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn biiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria mumua'da' gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Esekîas bɨx vaak jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ' vaak vaak jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Millo kiicham gu Dabii tu' jix duu mumua'da' u'uux guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu' bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios kua' bhaan gu Lakîs bɨɨx bɨx bɨxchu'x bhañ tu duukam gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Judaa mi'p gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem gu noobh gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu noobh bɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' mui'x aichdhak gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chutumñigam juana'; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp mi' dhɨr dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ koi'm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix maa nɨi'ñchudat.

Gu' gu' gu Esekîas cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' xoi'kam ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Esekîas mi' dhɨr tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham suudai' u'va bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Esekîas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Esekîas namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai a'bhar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' dhi' na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaakax guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim gu suudai' gu Gioon jiix guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tas gei'ñ kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Esekîas bɨx jix duu.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' gu Babiloonia mɨjɨ na ba' maachim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix maati' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Esekîas i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx ua'nak ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix koox gu Esekîas bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn pai'm gu ma'nkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ koi'm bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Manasees gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Doke guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chɨbɨɨp ka't baas gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Esekîas gu taat ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix búup jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jerusalem ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu innom; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu jiim ka't jix maa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' jix dhaas na jax chu'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jerusalem tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt gu Israeel gu oidha' tu' kapbhai' tattat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' jix duu bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Manasees tu jiim gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Manasees gu ja'tkam gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Manasees gu ñi'ook bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhɨɨk gu Babiloonia.

Gu' gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' dhaibu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' jix kai soi'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Manasees gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' vaak jodai guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kiicham gu Dabii tas gei'ñ gu Gioon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ba'k ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Opel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kavɨk gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mai' kiicham.

Jano' ba' tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Manasees soi'm gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx ua'nak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu soi'm gio gu ñi'ook ka't naak bɨx uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga pai' pai'x guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' duiñxim va'k guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu'x ua'ñix gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manasees bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amoon gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Amoon na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Manasees gu taat; na gu' bɨx duiñxim gu taat gu Manasees ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Amoon.
Gu' gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Manasees gu taat; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak.

Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.

Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Oko guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Josiiyas na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham tu jiim kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kua'da' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kua'da' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales tu' bapaalh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tas mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oo' bhaan pai'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn o'oo jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh gu Manasees gu Epraim gu Simeoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Neptalii bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xikoolh.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx duiñxim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu vaak bhañ gu Sapaan gu mar gu Asaliias gu Maasiias guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham gu Joa gu mar gu Joakâs guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa tuumiñ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ gu Manasees gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm daam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu jodai tɨ'ya' gu u'u na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jaat gu Abdiias gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari; mi' dhɨr gu Sakâriias gu Mesullam gu ma'nkam gu Koat na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu duukam; jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx pui'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm daam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam; gio ba' gu Lebitas ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tuumiñ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ilkiias gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' gaagam u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ilkiias u'uan gu Sapaan.

Jano' ba' gu Sapaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bham; gio ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx ka't jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tuumiñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhagia' gu novɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ xoi'kam tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' jix duu gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ilkiias jix maa u'uan; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Sapaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix kai gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu ilkiias gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu Abdoon gu mar gu Mikâ gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Asaiia tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel gu Judaa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook u'uan tu' gaagam; na gu' jix gɨ' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan no'ch na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak dhi' u'uan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ilkiias gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu ulda guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ gu Sallum gu mar gu Tikbat gu mar gu asra jix nukadham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem gu vaak mamtuxi'ñdha'; gio ba' gui'p gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham bhai' bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ua'ñix u'uan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨi gu noobh; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam i'iich guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan dhi' pai' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook u'uan.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gio tu' naak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat ka' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ pai'm bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vupui cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ jum daa'ñ bɨx daraa gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix ali'; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga maatɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gaagam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu kua' gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan mi'p ua'ñix mii' dhɨr u'uan.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx mi'p gu Jerusalem gu Benjamiin; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem jix duu jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josiiyas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tattat bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josiiyas gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' xidhuu gu vaak pai'x gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Salomoon gu mar.
Jano' ba' dhi' xidhuu bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhaan duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam na ba' xoi'kam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas gu ja'tkam kakneer ali' karneer chiiw guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu vaakax bɨx na ba' gakdhi'ñchix na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gio chiñia' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu ilkiias gu Sakâriias gu Jeiel chiñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gakdhi'ñchix gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kakneer vaik gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu Kônaniias gu Semeiias gu Natanael gu ja'tkam gu asabiias gu Jeiel gu Josabad chiñia' gu Lebitas jix maa gu Lebitas na ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gakdhi'ñchix jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Lebitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ gu Lebitas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ua'nak u'uan gu Moisees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gakdhi'ñchix gu tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; na gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu tukaa' gu maa'nkar maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Lebitas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Asap mi'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gio tu jiim mi'p ki'ñgob; na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gakdhi'ñchix maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix duu gakdhi'ñchix mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu takarui' cham jabka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim gakdhi'ñchix ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Israeel dɨr gu tanoolh gu Samueel jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duu gakdhi'ñchix tu jiim na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' dhi' gakdhi'ñchix ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Josiiyas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Nekâo gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Karkêmis ju'ñdharan gu Euprates; gio ba' jix buus gu Josiiyas bhaan.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tañia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Gu' gu' gu Josiiyas cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui va'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Nekâo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' suudai' u'va jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ yooxi' gu Megiddo.

Jano' ba' u'u gat jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix dhaas gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ga'ra' bhɨɨk gu Jerusalem jix koi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai'm tattat; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josiiyas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josiiyas bɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu Josiiyas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel ua'ñix gu Lamentakiones.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Josiiyas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam buimɨi jurtu'nka' ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dharka' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix bhɨɨ gu Joakâs gu mar gu Josiiyas tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu taat gu Jerusalem.
Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Joakâs na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaik masaa'n jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cha'tmam jix toja jodai maa'n jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto xibhɨk gu Eliakim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Joakim; gio ba' gu Joakâs xibhɨk jix bhɨɨ gu Nekâo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joakim ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Nabukodonosor gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joakim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joakîn gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Joakîn na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' vaik masaa'n mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor bhañ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Babiloonia bɨɨma'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Sedekiias xibhɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Sedekiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ua'rgidhimɨk baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Nabukodonosor ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ na ba' cham jix joi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gio bɨx chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix duu kɨkbo gu xibh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' ga'ra' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ja'tkam ba'bhak.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm jix tɨ'ɨ i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Kaldeos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam biipibop gu vaak xidhuu cham uañchuda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' bɨx do'ñcho gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaak jodai gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tai bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Na guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Persas.

Na ba' na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix utu'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' maa'n oidha' tas gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persas na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu Judaa; jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham tu'x jai'ch bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
